overview: From 2026-09-22 to 2026-09-23, ethereum-optimism/optimism had 2 new PRs (0 merged), 0 new issues, and 2 active contributors.

topPRs.title: op-supernode: Prevent local-safe promotion while verified state is stale
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
An L1 reorg can pull local-safe back below the last verified interop timestamp. In that window the supernode never rewinds its verified state, and the node labels blocks as safe that no chain verified. The next round asks for a timestamp above local-safe, so the readiness check fails with `ethereum.NotFound` and the round returns before it checks the accepted L1 inclusion. Derivation then advances local-safe on the new canonical branch, and the engine controller returned local-safe because the recorded verified head was ahead. The forkchoice update sent that unverified block as the safe hash.

The supernode now checks the accepted L1 inclusion before the frontier, and a rewind takes priority over a wait. The engine controller now uses the cross-safe fallback, which returns the validated cross-safe cache or finalized state.

Operators see the safe tag hold at the last verified block instead of advancing during this window. The safe tag also holds after a resync until local-safe passes the verified head. The extra L1 call per not-ready round can turn a transient L1 failure into a logged round error, where the round was silent before.

Fixes ethereum-optimism/optimism#22845

topPRs.title: op-supernode: Do not invalidate blocks on log storage errors
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
Op-supernode treated every executing-message verification error as proof that the
message broke the interop rules. A local log store failure therefore invalidated an
otherwise valid L2 block. The raft WAL log store returns a read error or a
block-record decode error from `Contains`, and the verification round turned that
error into `DecisionInvalidate`. A node with a damaged local log store could replace
a correct block.

The round now separates the errors that report an invalid message from local
failures. A local failure aborts the round, the same way an `OpenBlock` failure
already aborts it. The activity logs the error, counts it, and retries the round
after the error backoff.

Effect on operators: a node with a healthy log store sees no change. A node with a
damaged log store stalls on the affected timestamp instead of invalidating a block.
The stall is visible through the `ActivityErrors` counter for the interop activity.
An operator must repair the log store to make the node progress again.

Fixes ethereum-optimism/optimism#22846

Both review agents asked whether `ErrUnknownChain`, `ErrFuture` and `ErrSkipped`
also report local state rather than an invalid message. This PR keeps their current
treatment, because that question is separate from the storage-error bug. Tell me if
you want a follow-up issue.
